repackFeatures: Based on two Switch game releases with update v1.0.2: 8.4 GB; thanks to those who knows who I’m talking about 🙂
Yuzu Switch emulator Mainline v541 is included
Shader caches for both games are included and enabled by default for smoother gameplay – you may delete them in games properties by opening and cleaning transferrable cache folder
100% Lossless, but not MD5 Perfect: all files are identical to originals after installation, but the encryption on Switch containers was removed to improve compression ratio
Significantly smaller archive size (compressed from 8.4 to 1.2 GB)
After-install integrity check so you could make sure that everything installed properly
Language can be changed in games settings
It’s recommended to disable dock mode for these games (check left bottom corner of the emulator)
If you enable Vulkan option instead of OpenGL, shader cache will not work, but you still may have better perfomance
You MUST enable Handheld mode in emu controller settings (Emulation -> Configure -> Controls -> Player 1 -> Connect Controller -> Handheld)
Intro movie display is bugged AF, but it’s the only movie in these games, so just bear with it
At least 3 GB of free RAM (inc. virtual) required for installing this repack
gameDescriptionHtml: Journey through the Kanto region on an exciting adventure in Pokemon: Let’s Go, Pikachu! and Pokemon: Let’s Go, Eevee! for Nintendo Switch. Start your journey as a rookie Pokemon Trainer, and catch, battle and form friendships with many Pokemon along the way!
